q.g: In this quest you have to kill any 15 enemies with headshots using a 7.62x51mm NATO assault rifle or designated marksman rifle. You can use any of the following: * DS Arms SA58 7.62x51 assault rifle * Desert Tech MDR 7.62x51 assault rifle * FN SCAR-H 7.62x51 assault rifle * FN SCAR-H X-17 7.62x51 assault rifle * HK G28 7.62x51 marksman rifle * Kalashnikov AK-308 7.62x51 assault rifle * Kel-Tec RFB 7.62x51 rifle * Knight's Armament Company SR-25 7.62x51 marksman rifle * Remington R11 RSASS 7.62x51 marksman rifle * Springfield Armory M1A 7.62x51 rifle
